project.name: Ethie Castle
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full sequential audit. Five listed buildings and two NRHE records are retained and all seven visible pins have defensible material dates. The current operator markets whole-castle rental and residential retreats; no normal walk-in opening contract, public See attraction, cafe-led Eat, named trail, picnic place, public parking or public toilet was verified. No exact product was found at the four named trail providers. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: A private historic estate and bookable whole-castle accommodation, not an independently visitable settlement or a walk-in public attraction.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: No public dog visit or access policy is published for non-guests; surrounding farmland requires responsible close control.

townGuide.headline: Exceptional fabric, but no public settlement visit
townGuide.intro: Ethie Castle scores 28% and remains in the selector but off the town map. Its Category A castle and estate buildings are richly dated heritage; the current operator offers private rental and residential retreats rather than dependable walk-in public admission.
perfectFor: Recognising the private estate on a wider Angus route

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Book before approaching
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Use the operator’s official site for whole-castle rental or retreat enquiries; do not assume public access to the house, garden or estate roads.

townGuide.suggestedTime: No public settlement visit; duration applies only to a booked stay
townGuide.visitorMood: A private, working historic estate rather than a village or visitor attraction.
